scope: 从已取得导出中选取可见用户/助手消息；不含内部推理、工具日志或授权码。不声称完整平台记录；保留来源顺序，文件之间可能重叠。子代理初始指令未必由导出接口返回；不能据助手回复条数推定实现调用次数。

messages.text: I’ll read the diff, calculate the requested finding floor, and check the changed behavior for missing cases and integration gaps.

The core transaction logic handles capacity conflicts and audit rollback carefully. I’m now checking the edges around browser state, identifier handling, and whether the verification evidence proves the behavior it claims.

I reproduced three browser edge cases: large room IDs lose precision, valid integer number-field formats are rejected, and newline characters accepted by the API are silently removed by the edit field. I also confirmed that an expired directory refresh asks the user to retry while disabling the refresh button.

- Finding floor: 833,589 bytes ÷ 1,000 = 833.589 kB; N = min(⌊√833.589 + 1⌋, 10) = min(29, 10) = **10**.
- Preserve 64-bit room IDs without JavaScript rounding in [rooms.js](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/rooms.js:38). `Number("9007199254740993")` becomes `9007199254740992`, and `Number.isInteger` accepts it. Selecting a valid server-side ID can therefore update a different room or return an erroneous 404. Use a lossless identifier representation consistently.
- Make accepted room text round-trip through the editor in [admin.html](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/templates/admin.html:25). The API accepts embedded newlines, but the single-line inputs remove them: an API-created name `"a\nb"` becomes `"ab"` when selected for editing. Either reject unsupported line breaks during validation or preserve them in the editor.
- Detect stale edits in [services.py](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/services.py:144). Two administrator tabs can load the same room; one renames it, then the other changes capacity and silently restores the old name through the complete-object update. The transaction serializes writes but does not prevent lost edits. Add an expected-version or original-value precondition.
- Align capacity parsing with the number input in [rooms.js](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/rooms.js:82). Chrome considers `1e2`, `10.0`, and `01` valid integer values for this control, but the regex converts each to `null` and sends it to the server. Parse the numeric value and validate its integer/range properties, or use an input whose validation matches the canonical-text restriction.
- Preserve the authentication-specific refresh message in [rooms.js](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/rooms.js:127). `sessionError()` disables all controls and requests login, but the catch immediately replaces that explanation with “请手动重试”. This reproduces as a retry instruction beside a disabled refresh button; the successful-save refresh catch has the same contradiction.
- Validate error DTOs before rendering conflicts in [rooms.js](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/rooms.js:108). An otherwise accepted error envelope containing `conflicts: [{}]` throws an unhandled `TypeError` at `.replace()`, while a non-array value can fail iteration. Treat malformed fields/conflicts as an unknown response and retain the normal recovery path.
- Provide a usable recovery path for the preserved expired-session draft in [admin.html](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/templates/admin.html:33). The login link navigates away from the only copy of the draft, and `blocked` has no recovery transition even if login happens elsewhere. Preserve the draft through explicit reauthentication and require fresh confirmation before any submission.
- Reset confirmation when the draft changes in [rooms.js](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/rooms.js:79). Once checked, confirmation remains valid through arbitrary field edits and failed submissions. Bind confirmation to the values actually reviewed, clearing it on relevant input changes.
- Retain sanitized failure diagnostics in [verify_room_management_browser.py](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_room_management_browser.py:75). A failed driver discards its captured stdout/stderr, replaces the cause with a generic `RuntimeError`, and later deletes the temporary server log. Preserve the failing assertion and sanitized diagnostics alongside `INCOMPLETE` so failed verification remains reviewable.
- Add room-management lock-contention recovery coverage in [test_room_management.py](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_room_management.py:24) and [test_rooms_js.cjs](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_rooms_js.cjs:1). The new tests and runners never exercise `STORE_BUSY`/503. Hold an independent write lock through timeout, verify zero room/audit changes, then verify that the browser retains the draft, restores controls, and allows a deliberate successful retry.
